lines.zh: 我的嗓子哑了，只能嘶嘶。
lines.en: My voice is gone; only hissing remains.
Stumble, searching for sustenance.
Move slowly, murmur.
Chew on decayed flesh.
Stagger forward.
Drag feet forward.
Chomping constantly.
Mutter, seeking prey.
Chew, low groan.
Move slowly, make noise.
I drag my hurt leg around the ruins.
I count the remaining cans as I walk.
Stand against the wall, eerie.
Lean against the wall, dazed.
Idle, muttering softly.
Lean on the wall, mutter.
Lazy stand.
Half-closed eyes, mumbling.
Stand against wall, whispering.
Idle, mutter non-stop.
Lean against wall, whisper.
Half-closed eyes, soft speech.

lines.zh: 我把水壶往身后藏了藏。
lines.en: I tuck my canteen a little further behind me.

lines.zh: 我在看你手上有没有咬痕。
lines.en: I am checking your hands for bite marks.
Gaze at you, wanting to approach.
Greedy eyes.
Sharp gaze, seeking prey.
Fixed gaze, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我把背包带子又勒紧一格。
lines.en: I cinch my pack strap one notch tighter.
Desire in eyes.
Lock onto you, ready to attack.
Ruthless gaze, staring.
My skin is splitting — is it turning?
Bandage me up — I can hold on.
I need...
Help me...
I'm bleeding...
Don't leave me...

lines.zh: 我背上的包压着伤口，好重。
lines.en: The pack on my back presses on the wound.

lines.zh: 纱布绕了三圈，还是红的。
lines.en: Three wraps of gauze, and it is red again.
The old wound on my leg split open again...
The bleeding won't stop. Press it down...

lines.zh: 你那块面包真香，不如给点我吧？
lines.en: That bread smells good. Want to trade?

lines.zh: 别看我这么吓人，其实我很温和。
lines.en: Don't be scared. I'm actually quite gentle.

lines.zh: 我的骨头能给你补充营养，可以吗？
lines.en: My bones can give you nutrition. Deal?
Don't be afraid. I can help you find food.

lines.zh: 一起生存吧，我们可以互相帮助。
lines.en: Let's survive together. We can help each other.

lines.zh: 你看，我把这些果实给你，换点面包如何？
lines.en: Look, I'll give you these fruits for some bread.

lines.zh: 我有医疗知识，也许能帮你。
lines.en: I know medical stuff. Maybe I can help.

lines.zh: 给我点食物，我可以为你驱赶敌人。
lines.en: Give me some food. I can protect you from enemies.

lines.zh: 我们一起行动，互相照顾。
lines.en: Let's work together. Watch each other's back.

lines.zh: 你看看我这，你愿意试试合作吗？
lines.en: Check me out. Want to try working together?

lines.zh: 嘿，小心点，我可不是敌人。
lines.en: Hey, be careful. I'm not the enemy.
Don't touch me. I'll fight back.
You hit me. That's not good.
Oops, I accidentally hit you.

lines.zh: 你这行为有点危险，小心点。
lines.en: Your behavior is a bit dangerous. Be careful.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞上你的，谁都没让。
lines.en: My shoulder hits yours; neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我可能会攻击你。
lines.en: Don't come closer. I might attack.

lines.zh: 你太莽撞了，这不太安全。
lines.en: You're too reckless. This isn't safe.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我会生气的。
lines.en: You hit me. I'll be angry.
Warning, don't do that again.

lines.zh: 找个安静地方，我们可以在一起。
lines.en: Find a quiet place, we can be together.

lines.zh: 我喜欢你，愿意和我在一起吗？
lines.en: I like you. Want to be with me?

lines.zh: 我们可以互相保护，一起生存。
lines.en: We can protect each other. Let's survive together.

lines.zh: 来，让我们交配，延续生命。
lines.en: Come, let's mate and continue life.

lines.zh: 我想和你在一起，能做我的伴侣吗？
lines.en: I want to be with you. Can I be your mate?

lines.zh: 我们可以一起建造家园。
lines.en: We can build a home together.

lines.zh: 我需要你，你愿意做我的伴侣吗？
lines.en: I need you. Will you be my mate?

lines.zh: 我们共同抵抗外界威胁。
lines.en: We'll resist external threats together.

lines.zh: 一起面对未来的挑战吧。
lines.en: Face future challenges together.
Will you spend the rest of your life with me?

lines.zh: 拿走我的剑吧，它不再属于我了。
lines.en: Take my sword. It no longer belongs to me.
This knife is my companion.

lines.zh: 这片面包是给你的，但我不确定它是否安全。
lines.en: Here, take this bread. I'm not sure if it's safe.

lines.zh: 火把是我的朋友，照亮了黑暗。
lines.en: My torch is a friend, lighting the dark.

lines.zh: 我找到了一些补给，但不值得分享。
lines.en: I found some supplies, but they're not worth sharing.

lines.zh: 用我的盔甲保护自己，就像保护生命一样。
lines.en: Protect yourself with my armor, like protecting life.

lines.zh: 这罐食物应该还够你吃一会儿。
lines.en: This food jar should last you a while.

lines.zh: 我的药水可以让你恢复活力。
lines.en: My potion can rejuvenate you.

lines.zh: 这是我的地图，可能会对你有帮助。
lines.en: This map might be helpful to you.

lines.zh: 我的背包里有一些你可能需要的东西。
lines.en: My backpack has some things you might need.

lines.zh: 看到你了，准备好战斗吗？
lines.en: I see you. Are you ready for battle?

lines.zh: 你的出现让我感到不安。
lines.en: Your appearance unsettles me.
I must protect this place.

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则你会后悔的。
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有对话的空间。
lines.en: There's no room for dialogue between us.

lines.zh: 我会保护这里的每一个幸存者。
lines.en: I will protect every survivor here.

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我需要空间。
lines.en: You're too close. I need space.
You won't be随意闯入ing without my permission.

lines.zh: 保持距离，否则你会遭到攻击。
lines.en: Keep your distance, or you'll be attacked.
Stay away from me. I'm dangerous.
You are no one I know.
Stop. Not one step closer.
We hold this place.
I still have an axe in hand.
Show who you are before you speak.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你倒下。
lines.en: I will watch you until you fall.

lines.zh: 我会跟踪你，直到你崩溃。
lines.en: I will follow you until you collapse.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你露出破绽。
lines.en: I will watch you until you make a mistake.

lines.zh: 我会注视你，直到你露出弱点。
lines.en: I will watch you until you show a weakness.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你屈服。
lines.en: I will watch you until you yield.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你不再移动。
lines.en: I will watch you until you no longer move.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你求饶。
lines.en: I will watch you until you beg for mercy.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你成为我的俘虏。
lines.en: I will watch you until you become my captive.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你屈服于我。
lines.en: I will watch you until you submit to me.

lines.zh: 我将注视你，直到你完全臣服。
lines.en: I will watch you until you are completely submissive.

lines.zh: 我数着你腰间的绷带卷。
lines.en: I count the bandage rolls at your belt.
You move, I move.
My grip on the haft is tight.
Step back. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上还剩几发。
lines.en: I'm counting how many shots you have left.
Keep your hand out of your pocket.
This hand will not shake.

lines.zh: 你喘得那么重，藏不住了。
lines.en: You're breathing that hard; you can't hide.
Chews on corpse, hisses.
Decaying skin touches ground.
Waving decayed arms.
Approaches prey, hisses.
Scratches at decayed hands.
Decayed palms grab player.
Bites player, mouth full of decay.
Decaying nails scratch player.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂试图拥抱玩家。
lines.en: Decayed arm tries hugging player.
Tearing decayed flesh.
The axe's flat hits your hand first.
I held back on that one.
The blood on my hands is still dripping.
I drive you back, not down.
I aimed for your leg.
A wound teaches obedience.
Rising from ashes.
Appears near rotten grave.
Emerges from old camp.
Appears under ratty tent.
Crawls out of earth.
Appears in abandoned building.
Emerges from darkness.
On edge of ruined town.
Emerges from rotten tree.
Appears in ruins.
I come out from behind a flipped car.
Half a body emerges from the rubble.
I wait with my axe in both arms.
This used to be my home.
Fire burns my flesh...

lines.zh: 我扶着货架，膝盖在打颤。
lines.en: I brace on a shelf, my knees shaking.
Water filled my lungs...
Explosion hurt me...
Arrow hit me...
Magic burn my skin...
I'm starving...
Lightning struck me...

lines.zh: 我连遗书都没来得及写。
lines.en: I never even wrote a last note.
